scope: 110 unique method x dataset pairs across 17 methods and 7 datasets: the 124-pair roster of 2026-11-03 without CentP and GDEM.
unit: Equal weight per unique method x dataset pair; average its matched node-budget settings or saved edge graphs before thresholding.
threshold_rule: strict <; only pairs with published numerical references enter either numerator or denominator; no completion credits
exclusions: Clustering, published-only GEOM/SFGC rows, whole-graph baselines and other undeclared/unreferenced cells remain excluded. The eight newly documented GC4NC cells are now included. CentP and GDEM are excluded from numerical reference comparison because their references were generated with defective implementations (see roster_revision_20261106).
protocol_scope: Cumulative frozen reruns with method-specific provenance replay, validation-selected HPO, and historical baselines; not a single uniform new run of the current checkout. Per-pair evaluation_profile identifies adopted reruns; historical_frozen denotes inherited results. The eight added pairs share their underlying archived observations with the revised GC4NC tables and are not independent replication runs.

reference_corrections.rule: Where GC4NC v3 main-text Table 1 and Appendix Table 9 disagree, Table 1 is authoritative; the Table 9 Pubmed 0.02% K-Center cell (79.18) is a transcription error and belongs to TSpanner (absent from Table 1).
evidence: arXiv 2406.16715v3 Table 1, Pubmed 0.02%: Herding 62.91, K-Center 62.91, Averaging 75.60 (checked live 2026-11-01)
Table 9 Pubmed 0.02%: K-Center 79.18±0.2 (above Whole 78.6), TSpanner 62.91±1.5 (duplicate of Herding), Averaging 74.09±0.6
output/reproduction_90pct_20261031/reference_discrepancies.json recorded the two Table 1/Table 9 conflicts on 2026-10-31 without acting on them

roster_revision.basis: User requested removal of Clustering without a published numerical comparison.

cohort_expansion.historical_Yelp_metric: macro-F1 for the existing 13 Yelp pairs
cohort_expansion.new_Yelp_metric: AP for the added TSpanner/Yelp and GDEM/Yelp pairs; matched within each pair

roster_revision_20261106.basis: Remove CentP and GDEM from the reference comparison after fixing defects that also affected the implementation that produced their GC4NC references. Whole methods are removed on all seven datasets, including pairs that met the tolerance before and after the fixes.

reasons.cent_p: GraphSlim's CentP PageRank update applied a row-stochastic transition matrix without transposing it (introduced 2024-05-29 in commit 14499d5, before GC4NC's first arXiv version), so every node with an edge kept the uniform score 1/n. GC4NC's CentP references were generated with that implementation. The defect is fixed after 1.3.1 (commit 6e3974a); the references therefore do not describe the corrected method.
reasons.gdem: GraphSlim's GDEM (added 2024-08-17) optimized synthetic features from uninitialized memory and, on Cora and Citeseer, filled its largest-component training map with validation, test and unlabeled nodes and their labels. GC4NC's GDEM references were generated with that implementation. Both defects are fixed after 1.3.1 (commit 6e3974a); the references therefore do not describe the corrected method.
